versions.content: Enable/disable Events by configuration The configuration pa- rameter DemEventAvailableInVariant shall be used as master to consider an Event as enabled or disabled. If the configuration parameter DemEventAvail- ableInVariant is set to FALSE, the Dem shall treat the Event as if it is not config- ured as DemEventParameter . If DemEventAvailableInVariant is not set or set to TRUE, the Dem shall consider the Event as enabled depending on other sources.
